Are there still..... y'know, stealth mechanics? Like are there modes like in MGS4's MGO? Where sneaky elements are really important to specific game modes? Or is it just 3rd person Counterstrike?

You can still sneak. People see you on the radar if you go in guns blazing. There is also stealth (the item) and sneaking. Accurate headshots and knowing how the game works is really important. Really not that friendly for beginners in my opinion.

My biggest gripe is having to launch the game.

  • Launch MGSV

  • Choose multiplayer

  • MGSV shuts down

  • MGO starts

  • MGO forces you to accept all the new changes and updates

  • Choose a game

  • Connect to a server

  • Server is laggy

  • Choose a new server, this time realizing there is a ping meter

  • Host ragequits

  • Round restarts

  • Realize game is P2P

  • Play a laggy match where snipers kill you and pro players stomp you because of the bad matchmaking

  • Welcome to MGO!

This is of course the worst case scenario and exaggerating the issues. The game is however pretty repetitive. There are some people that really enjoy this gameplay, so you should give it a try if you own MGSV. If you're planning to buy the game just for online, don't do it unless you were a fan of original MGO.
